import 'package:artificer_core/artificer_core.dart';
import 'package:artificer_core/json.dart';
import 'package:conflux/conflux.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  try {
    FixtureModel('');
    throw StateError('Expected an empty model ID to fail.');
  } on ArgumentError {
    // Expected local invariant failure.
  }
  final concrete = FixtureModel('future-model');
  final LanguageModel common = concrete;
  final result = await common.generate(
    GenerationRequest(messages: [UserMessage.text('hello')]),
  ).runFuture();
  final overridden = await concrete.generate(
    GenerationRequest(messages: [UserMessage.text('hello')]),
    options: const FixtureOptions(prefix: 'typed'),
  ).runFuture();
  final events = await concrete.stream(
    GenerationRequest(messages: [UserMessage.text('hello')]),
    options: const FixtureOptions(prefix: 'stream'),
  ).runCollect().runFuture();

  if (result.text != 'hello' || overridden.text != 'typed:hello') {
    throw StateError('Unexpected generation result.');
  }
  if (events.single is! GenerationFinished) {
    throw StateError('Unexpected stream result.');
  }
}

final class FixtureOptions {
  const FixtureOptions({this.prefix});

  final String? prefix;
}

final class FixtureModel implements LanguageModel {
  FixtureModel(this.modelId) {
    if (modelId.isEmpty) throw ArgumentError.value(modelId, 'modelId');
  }

  @override
  final String modelId;

  @override
  String get providerId => 'fixture';

  @override
  ModelCapabilities get capabilities => ModelCapabilities({
    ModelCapability.textGeneration: CapabilitySupport.supported,
    ModelCapability.streaming: CapabilitySupport.supported,
  });

  @override
  Effect<GenerationResult, AiError> generate(
    GenerationRequest request, {
    FixtureOptions? options,
  }) {
    final text = (request.messages.single as UserMessage).parts.single as TextInputPart;
    final prefix = options?.prefix;
    return Effect.succeed(
      _result(prefix == null ? text.text : '$prefix:${text.text}'),
    );
  }

  @override
  Flow<GenerationEvent, AiError> stream(
    GenerationRequest request, {
    FixtureOptions? options,
  }) => Flow.defer(() => generate(request, options: options).asFlow().map(GenerationFinished.new));

  GenerationResult _result(String text) {
    final payload = NativePayload(
      providerId: providerId,
      api: 'fixture',
      modelId: modelId,
      json: JsonObject({'text': text}),
    );
    return GenerationResult(
      message: AssistantMessage([TextOutputPart(text)]),
      finishReason: FinishReason.stop,
      nativePayload: payload,
      metadata: ResponseMetadata(statusCode: 200),
    );
  }
}
